translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Tesalonicenses

content: Ani Pablo, Silvano, degine, Timoteo, anmar bemarse garda narmakmalad, bemar Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-Tesalónica-neggweburgi-ambikunoni-damaladse, bemar Bab Dummadgi, degi, Dummad-Jesucristogi akananaimaladse. Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, degine, Dummad-Jesucristo, amar bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin, degine, ulubgi bogidik bemar-itogega imakbalina-yerban.
Bemar Bab-Jesúsba nue-naid-ular, anmar gusgu Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogdiguad, degine, anmar Bab Dummadse gorsi sogele, bemarga Bab Dummadse goled gwen surgudisurbalid.

Ar Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, a-asabin anmar bemar-gwen-iedisurmalad, bemar Jesúsgi-bensuli arbasmalad, bemar sabedgi be ibmar imakmalad, degine, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristobina nue bensuli-edarbedimaladgi be alamaknanaimalad.

¿Igi anmar wissunna? Ar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued unnila gayaginbi bemar abingassulidba, ar ade bemar nue oyosmalad, bemar nue Bab-Jesús-abingasmalad, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-nue-nikamalad, degine, we-igar nue-napiragwadye bemar oyogedba. Aginbali, bemar wismarbalid, igi bemar-abargi anmar bemar-sabedba gudigusa.
Degisoggu, bemar anmar-daedba, degi, Bab-Jesús-daedba nanadigusmalad. Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba bemar beedse-wilesmalad-abargi abingasmar-inigwele, weligwar bemar Bab Dummad Burba Nuedgi abingasmalad.
Degisoggu, belagwapa Bab-Jesúsgi-bensurmalad Macedonia-yargi-bukmaladga, degi, Acaya-yargi-bukmaladga, bemar be-daedgi, nue be oyosmalad, igi Bab-Jesúsba-nair nanamalar-gebe.

Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba bemarba unnila Macedonia-yalaganba, degine, Acaya-yalaganbarbi mimmilessulid. Bela nega-gwen-obessuli, Bab-Dummadgi-bemar-bensulid bemargi sunmakedbimalad. Degisoggu, geg anmar bemargi bar sunmaksundo, ar bela bato bemar-wismalad.

Bela anmarga sogedbimalad igi bemar anmar-abingasa, anmar bese mosmargu, degi, igi bemar bab-dummadga-imakleged-metemala, Bab-Dummad-dulasaila-maid, Bab-Dummad-napiragwad, asebi golegar, e-nug odummogegar.

Anmarga sogmarbalid, bemarde Bab-Dummad-Machi nibneg-akar gannar-danikoed edarbebukmarye. Bab Dummad na E-Machi-Jesús burgwar-maigu gannar odulosad. A-Jesúsde dulemar-Bab-Dummadse-dummad-odurdaklegoedgi anmar-abonosad.
